nav.intro: Your personal map of next roles: how ready you are on the required competencies, which entry conditions you already meet, and what would close the gap. Indicative guidance only: ENEC and FANR decide eligibility.

nav.readyNowSub: 85% or more on competencies and no unmet gate

map.desc: Your role, the roles one step away and two steps away. Colour shows readiness; the line shows the kind of move. Select a role for its gates and gaps.

pathOnlyHint: Security, safeguards and cyber roles show the career path only: readiness and gate detail are not computed.

short.full: Your shortlist already holds three roles: remove one first.
short.share: Share my shortlist with my line manager

reasons.gates_pending: Route "{route}": nothing blocks you; {n} condition(s) still to do or checked by the licensee
reasons.gates_not_met: Route "{route}": a gate is not met yet (about {months} months to go), so this role cannot be "ready now"

rm.intro: Lay your route to a target role out quarter by quarter: programmes with their published durations, FANR milestones, experience you still need and development. Change the what-ifs and the timeline recomputes.
rm.targetHint: Your shortlist first, then every role your progression routes reach.
rm.name: Scenario name
rm.noRoute: No progression route from your role to this one
rm.noRouteBody: The published career map has no route between these roles yet. Use the Navigator's "roles like mine" to find a lateral first step.
rm.routeHint: Alternative routes, for example the graduate route straight to SRO.
rm.rotationHint: Taken before the first programme: it can push the intake back.
rm.result: In this scenario you reach the target on {date}.
rm.isEarliest: The earliest the gate conditions allow on this route
rm.beyond: This scenario runs beyond the {n}-year horizon; the timeline shows the first {n} years.
rm.timelineDesc: Quarter by quarter. The ringed blocks form the critical path; dashed blocks have indicative (SAMPLE) durations.
rm.exportNote: Durations marked indicative are SAMPLE values, not published figures. Kafa'a is not an authority: ENEC and FANR decide.
rm.sourcesDesc: Every duration shows where it comes from, or a SAMPLE tag when it is indicative.
rm.sendHint: Adds {n} development activities to your plan for this target (a draft plan is created if you have none). Sending again adds nothing twice.
rm.sendNone: Turn on mentoring, a rotation, the leadership course or gap courses to have something to send.
rm.confirmTitle: Send this roadmap to your development plan?
rm.confirmBody: {n} activities will be added to your development plan for {role}, as planned items. The change is recorded in the audit log and the NEXUS evidence ledger.
rm.savedDesc: Share a roadmap with your line manager for your next career conversation.
rm.disclaimer: Programme durations come from ENEC's published reports (SR2024, CNS) where available; exam and certification dates are indicative. FANR certifies operators; Kafa'a only mirrors.

aspHint.grow_vertical: Take the next step on my ladder

mob.other_sites: Open to other ENEC sites and offices

privacy.title: Who sees what
privacy.body: Your draft is private. When you share it, your line manager of record sees your preparation and agenda. HR only sees totals for groups of 10 or more. Talent review sees your aspiration only if you switch that on. Nobody else reads this record.

refuse.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
refuse.invalid: Some answers are missing or not valid. Check the form and try again.
refuse.no_line_manager: No line manager is recorded for you. Ask HR to update your record.
refuse.self_record: You cannot record your own career conversation.
refuse.not_manager: Only the line manager of record can record this conversation.
refuse.locked: This conversation is already acknowledged. Start a new one next cycle.
refuse.not_person: Only the employee can acknowledge their career conversation.

my.intro: Every six months you and your line manager talk about where you want to go. Kafa'a fills the agenda from your own records, you add your aspirations and goals, and the agreed actions go into your development plan.
my.managerSub: Holds the conversation and records the actions

agenda.title: Pre-filled agenda

agenda.qualsNone: Nothing expires in the next 12 months.
agenda.mirror: Mirrored from the licensee's training records. Kafa'a does not issue or extend qualifications.

prep.title: Your preparation
prep.desc: Your aspirations, mobility and goals. Save a draft any time; nothing is shared until you choose to share it.
prep.aspHint: Choose up to {n}. The first one you pick is your main aspiration.
prep.needAsp: Choose at least one aspiration to share your preparation.
prep.rotationOk: Open to a rotation or job shadowing
prep.rotationHint: Rotations are short placements in another team
prep.goal12Hint: One or two sentences in your own words
prep.goal3: Where would you like to be in 3 years?
prep.topics: Other topics you want to raise
prep.shareTalent: Show my aspiration in talent review
prep.shareTalentHint: Off by default. When on, talent review sees your aspirations, mobility and goals from your latest conversation. You can switch it off at any time.
prep.saveHint: A draft stays private to you.
prep.updateHint: Your manager sees the latest version.
prep.sharedTitle: Shared with your line manager on {date}
prep.sharedBody: You can still update it until the conversation is recorded.
prep.confirmBody: Your line manager of record will see your aspirations, goals and the agenda items you included, and gets a notification. HR sees only totals of 10 or more.
prep.none: No preparation was shared for this conversation.

actions.inPlan: In your development plan as draft activities

ack.title: Acknowledge the record
ack.question: Does this record reflect the conversation?
ack.agree: Yes, I agree with the record
ack.disagree: I acknowledge it, but I disagree with part of it
ack.needComment: Say briefly what you disagree with.
ack.coach: Add the focus role and weekly learning hours to my Learning Coach
ack.coachHint: The coach will plan your suggestions for this role.
ack.confirmAgree: The record is locked and your manager is notified. The agreed actions stay in your development plan.
ack.confirmDisagree: The record is locked with your comment and your manager is notified. The agreed actions stay in your development plan.

history.noneBody: Your first conversation will appear here once your line manager records it.

consent.confirmOff: Talent review will see "aspiration not shared". The change is recorded.

consent.doneOff: Your aspiration is no longer visible in talent review

team.intro: The people who report to you, with the six-monthly cadence. Open a person to see what they shared, the pre-filled agenda and suggested actions, and record the conversation. Only they can acknowledge it.
team.none: Nobody reports to you on record
team.noneBody: Career conversations are held by the line manager of record. If this is wrong, ask HR to update the reporting line.
team.reportsSub: People whose line manager you are
team.overdueSub: No conversation in the last 6 months
team.listDesc: Shared preparations first, then by how overdue the conversation is.
team.remindBody: Everyone in an overdue pair gets a notification ({n} overdue now). Each person is reminded at most once a month.

ws.noPrep: {name} has not shared a preparation yet. You can still record the conversation; the agenda below holds only what they share with you.
ws.heldBody: Waiting for {name} to acknowledge. You can amend the record until then.

sugg.title: Suggested actions
sugg.desc: From the agenda and the preparation: courses that close the top target's gaps, requalification, and actions that answer the stated aspirations. Each one says why.

rec.title: Record the conversation
rec.desc: Your notes, the focus role and the agreed actions. The actions go into {name}'s development plan as draft activities.

rec.confirmBody: {name} is notified and asked to acknowledge it. The {n} agreed actions are added to their development plan as draft activities. The record is written to the NEXUS evidence ledger.
rec.doneActions: Conversation recorded; the agreed actions are in the development plan as draft activities

ins.overdueSub: No conversation in the last 6 months

fs16.intro: Every current role carries one of three labels: Growing, Changing or Stable. The criteria and thresholds are published here, and past years' labels are kept so anyone can check whether a label held up.

meaning.growing: Demand for the skills this role needs is projected to grow and to outrun the people who hold them. Good moment to move in.
meaning.changing: The role's 2030 profile adds or raises a large share of its requirements. Plan your learning now; the work is being redesigned, not removed.
meaning.stable: Neither the demand signal nor the profile-change signal crosses its threshold.

fs16.howDesc: Criteria version {v}, in force from {year}. The first rule that matches decides the label.
fs16.firstMatch: Rules are checked in this order. Components are percentages from the released skills outlook and the role profiles; no staffing numbers are ever used or shown.

rule.changing: The 2030 role profile adds or raises at least {pct} of today's requirement weight.
rule.growing: Projected demand for the role's skill families grows by at least {pct} to {year}, and demand stays above the people who hold those skills.

basis.change: FS05 role profiles: new requirements count their full level, raised ones the increase, weighted core 3, important 2, useful 1
basis.growth: Released skills outlook (SIMULATED), skill families weighted by how much the role needs them; the 5% line follows O*NET Bright Outlook
basis.shortfall: Pressure, kept apart from later demand: projected demand minus holders, as a share of demand

fs16.lineStaff: Median demand growth across labelled roles
fs16.rolesDescPublic: Every current role and its label for each year. Past labels stay as they were published.
fs16.rolesDescStaff: Every current role, its label for each year, and the components behind it (staff view).
fs16.publicNote: Public pages show the label only. Staff see the components behind each label when signed in. Security, safeguards and cyber roles appear at career-path level only and concept roles have no vacancy, so neither carries a label.
fs16.versionsDesc: When the criteria change, a new version is published; labels keep the version they were made under.

hr.title: This year's labels
hr.desc: Recompute the {year} labels from today's inputs and compare them with what is published. Only the HR director publishes; past years cannot be changed.
hr.onlyDirector: Only the HR director can publish.
hr.confirmBody: {n} role labels are published ({changed} change). The labels are public; the components stay staff-only. This is audited and recorded in the NEXUS evidence ledger.

fs16.disclaimer: Labels are planning signals built from SIMULATED outlook inputs and FS05 planning assumptions. They are not forecasts, carry no staffing numbers and imply no deployment decision. ENEC decides roles and vacancies.

reason.growing: Growing: demand growth and shortfall both cross their thresholds
reason.changing: Changing: the 2030 profile change crosses its threshold
reason.stable: Stable: no signal crosses its threshold
reason.change: Profile change by 2030: {pct}% of today's requirement weight (threshold {min}%)
reason.change_none: No profile change measured for this role
reason.growth_none: Demand growth not available (families suppressed in the outlook)
reason.shortfall: Demand above holders in {year}: {pct}% of demand
reason.archived: Archived label: kept as it was published that year
reason.simulated: Inputs are SIMULATED planning numbers, not forecasts
